exact_added_source_record.title: Rational-root height dichotomy and the complete three-by-three biform rank spectrum
exact_added_source_record.origin: Codex research directed by repository owner
exact_added_source_record.statement: Under AI-QUADRATIC-KERNEL-INDICES-001, let D be the primitive coefficient degree, L=ceil((a-1)D/2), U=floor(aD/2), and h the smallest K(x)-rational root height of the homogeneous z-quadratic, or infinity. Then min(L,(a+1)h)<=mu1<=min(U,(a+1)h). A minimum recurrence vector has Hankel rank two and degree at least L, or rank one and is a primitive coherent root vector of degree (a+1)h. Thus homogeneous irreducibility forces mu1 in [L,U], and (a+1)h<=L fixes both indices. For a=b=3, the nonzero biform-block rank spectrum is exactly {9,12,14,15} over every field, with universal witnesses; rank thirteen is impossible.
dependencies: De Teran-Dopico-Mackey, MIMS EPrint2013.47, August22 2013, Theorem6.5 over arbitrary fields
Explicit polynomial left and right Hankel kernel bases, primitive Gauss lemma, and coherent rank-one classification
exact_added_source_record.limitations: These are necessary index restrictions, not a classification of all splitting types. The complete rank spectrum concerns the fifteen-by-fifteen biform block, not every slice of the full cyclic tensor. No source-space cap, three-leg target, degeneration, independent review, formalization, historical priority or exponent improvement.
